company.shortDescription: Electron is an open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop applications with web technologies.
company.description: Electron is an open-source software framework for building cross-platform desktop applications using web technologies such as JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Electron provides APIs for native operating system access, application packaging, auto-updates, notifications, file system interaction, and inter-process communication.
